text:
sarah_sales: Heads-up — Resonance (30-seat pilot) is paused by the customer's legal team. They want explicit egress IPs + rate-limit guarantees and confirmation on retention. Sales needs an internal unblock by EOD so we don't lose momentum. Who can confirm NAT IPs + a fallback plan?

emma_engineering: Which items in their security questionnaire are blocking? exact QIDs would help (so legal can craft precise answers).

kate_legal: They've flagged Q12 (egress destination control), Q17 (data retention/rights to delete), and Q21 (access to in-memory caches/KV). I can draft language but need ops to confirm the IPs and retention options.

raj_ops: We can provide static egress NAT CIDR for the pilot: 198.51.100.0/27. We can also apply per-route throttles at the gateway level. Need customer's expected sustained QPS and burst numbers to size.

alec_cs: Customer says ~100 qps sustained, short bursts to 200 qps (30s windows). Most traffic is interactive chat, avg token sizes small.

michael_platform: Proposed quick plan: (1) provide the NAT CIDR above, (2) set route-level ceiling 150 QPS with burst 300, (3) automatic fallback to redwood-compact-v1 when throttled, (4) default content retention 30d but zero-content-retention available via contract addendum (we keep billing/meta 90d). That should satisfy their legal ask and keep pilot healthy.

emma_engineering: Technical config I suggest we push to ops:
```json
{
  "egress_ips": ["198.51.100.0/27"],
  "rate_limit": {"qps": 150, "burst": 300},
  "model_fallback": "redwood-compact-v1",
  "log_retention_days": 30
}
```

raj_ops: I'll provision the NAT and apply the per-route throttle. ETA ~4 hours. Will need legal-approved wording to send to customer's infra team so they can add to allowlist.

kate_legal: I approve the draft compromise: default 30d content retention, option for 0d via contract addendum, billing/meta retained 90d. I'll produce a short legal note (1 paragraph + signature block) the customer can accept.

michael_platform: I'll assemble a 1-page technical commitments doc (NAT CIDR, rate-limit, fallback model, retention summary) and cc @cto_james for quick signoff. ETA ~90 minutes.

deploy-bot: Route throttle policy 'resonance-pilot-1799954321' scheduled for 2026-03-22T15:40:00Z (deployment job id: deploy-7891)

alec_cs: I'll prepare the customer-facing message and schedule an exec bridge once we have the one-pager and NAT confirmation.

sarah_sales: Great — if ops confirms NAT done and legal sends the note, I'm ready to reopen the pilot and set the kickoff call. Please ping this thread when both are done.

cto_james: I'll sign off on the one-pager after a quick review. Thanks team, please @me when it's ready to send.
